properties.displayName: UAV Campaign C6 - Maintenance Implant → Firmware Tamper → SAR Target Exfil
properties.description: 장기 공급망 체인: 정비 중 임플란트(S21) → 펌웨어 해시 불일치 재확인(S4) → SAR 표적 허가구역 외 유출(S17). 연결키: UAVId. 윈도우: 24h. MITRE: T0864, T1542, T1020
properties.query:
let windowSize = 24h;
// S21: 정비 중 임플란트 (component_replace + HashMatch=false)
let S21 =
    UAVMaintenance_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(windowSize)
    | where EventType == 'component_replace'
    | join kind=inner (
        UAVPgse_CL
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(windowSize)
        | where HashMatch == false
        | project T_pgse=TimeGenerated, UAVId=tostring(UAVId)
    ) on UAVId
    | where T_pgse >= TimeGenerated and T_pgse <= TimeGenerated + 30m
    | project T1=TimeGenerated, UAVId=tostring(UAVId), ComponentName;
// S4: 펌웨어 해시 불일치 재확인
let S4 =
    UAVPgse_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(windowSize)
    | where HashMatch == false
    | project T2=TimeGenerated, UAVId=tostring(UAVId);
// S17: SAR 표적 허가구역 외 유출
let AuthArea = UAVC4I_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(windowSize)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AreaLat, AreaLon, AreaRadius_km) by MissionId;
let S17 =
    UAVSarPayload_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(windowSize)
    | join kind=leftouter (AuthArea) on MissionId
    | extend distKm = geo_distance_2points(
        toreal(TargetLon), toreal(TargetLat),
        toreal(AreaLon), toreal(AreaLat)) / 1000.0
    | where distKm > toreal(AreaRadius_km)
    | project T3=TimeGenerated, UAVId=tostring(UAVId), distKm;
S21
| join kind=inner (S4) on UAVId
| where T2 >= T1
| join kind=inner (S17) on UAVId
| where T3 >= T2
| extend CampaignType = "C6_정비임플란트_펌웨어변조_SAR표적유출"
| extend StepSummary = strcat("S21@", tostring(T1), "(", ComponentName, ") → S4@", tostring(T2), " → S17@", tostring(T3), "(", tostring(round(distKm,1)), "km)")
| extend Severity = "High"
| project T1, T2, T3, UAVId, ComponentName, distKm, CampaignType, StepSummary, Severity

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: [CAMPAIGN] UAV Campaign C6 - Maintenance Implant → Firmware Tamper → SAR Target Exfil - {{UAVId}}
